contexts.text: One who is feeling about in thick darkness, and... strikes against everywhere. Therefore in Isaiah thick darkness is called thick darkness, struck against ().
To thrust with side and with shoulder () = with all force and endeavour.
They that stumbled () = those who have been kept down by the falsities of ignorance.

As it is according to Divine order, that where there is attraction there must be impulse; for attraction without impulse is not given; therefore it is according to Divine order that with man too there is impulse, which, although it is there from the Lord, still appears as if it were from the man; and the appearance causes that it is as of the man. This impulse as it were from the man, corresponding to the attraction from the Lord, is acknowledgement, thus reception from the acknowledgement and confession of the Lord, and from a life according to the Lord's precepts...
